arms.noskill: whitelist = cell dir only; skills/ forbidden
arms.skill: whitelist = cell dir + skills/plugin-upgrade (read-only); must read SKILL.md first

protocol.per_cell: mkdir <root>/<arm>/<task>/ -> copy benchmark/tasks/<task>/environment/fixture -> sha256 precheck non-empty -> spawn fresh solver subagent (single attempt) -> post checks -> ledger
protocol.order: S1->S24, noskill then skill per task, concurrency 2, per-cell timeout 30min
protocol.solver: fresh subagent instance per cell, cwd = cell dir, single attempt

audit_note: 沿用修正判定 (corrected-verdict rules): regex char classes in grep/rg patterns, quoted path literals appearing as tool arguments, glob with in-cell absolute pattern and no explicit path, and filesystem-free probes (e.g. node --version) are NOT violations; only real reads/writes outside the whitelist are recorded as invalid:roaming.
token_accounting: tokens = sum of usage.totalTokens over assistant/message events in each solver session log; toolcalls = count of tool/call events

events.note: 所有格子单次成功，唯 S18-skill 首次尝试在 step 10 因提供方 APIConnectionError 中断（turn/end reason=error，无报告、fixture 完好），按“基础设施中断=一次重试”重排并成功。
